appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Reduced Screening Referrals Across Hospitals from 2012 to 2023'.
A single orange line plots screening referrals over time from 2012 to 2023.
The line starts at approximately 1200 referrals in 2012, rises to a peak of 3400 in 2022, and then declines to 3200 in 2023.

printed_facts.fact: The title states the chart covers the period from 2012 to 2023.
The y-axis is labeled 'Screening referrals' and has a scale from 0 to 3200 in increments of 800.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2012 to 2023.
In 2012, the value is approximately 1200 screening referrals.
In 2014, the value is approximately 1600 screening referrals.
In 2015, the value is approximately 1400 screening referrals.
In 2017, the value is approximately 1700 screening referrals.
In 2018, the value is approximately 2400 screening referrals.
